description: Fires its six outputs one after another, a set time apart, in the manner of a guitar strum. The run can start from any of the six

params.text: Sets the strum to run from output 6 towards output 1
Sets the strum to run from output 1 towards output 6
Starts a strum from that output onward by hand
Starts a strum across all six outputs by hand
Makes each strum run the opposite way round to the one before it
How much of the voltage at the strum time CV input reaches the gap between outputs

inputs.text: A trigger sets the strum to run from output 6 towards output 1
A trigger sets the strum to run from output 1 towards output 6
A trigger starts a strum from that output onward, so a strum can cover fewer than six outputs
A trigger starts a strum across all six outputs
A trigger switches alternating on and off
A voltage moving the gap between one output firing and the next

outputs.text: Fires when the strum reaches that output
Fires whenever a strum is started

notes: the gap between one output firing and the next is set by dragging the red display, up to 9.999 seconds, and is 10ms to begin with
